summary: Tests can be used with the select family of filters (select, reject, selectattr, rejectattr), for example keeping only defined variables or filtering a list of dicts by type equalto fixed.
questions: How do I filter a list of dicts to only those with a certain attribute value?
How do I remove undefined variables from a list?

answer_card.title: Filtering lists with tests
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml+jinja
good_vars: "{{ all_vars|select('defined') }}"
only_fixed: "{{ all_addresses|selectattr('type', 'equalto', 'fixed') }}"
not_fixed:  "{{ all_addresses|rejectattr('type', 'equalto', 'fixed') }}"
```
